headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while the market leader showed modest expansion.
summary: Coforge delivered the strongest top‑line growth at 53.6% YoY, driven by AI‑led services. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and grew only 1.5% YoY, reflecting a slowdown. Most peers posted mid‑single‑digit to low‑double‑digit growth, and AI revenue contributions were highlighted across several companies. Guidance ranges varied, with HCLTech introducing a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 target.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI as a key growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins remained stable for most, but lower‑growth firms faced tighter profitability.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Consistent double‑digit growth (11.2% YoY) and strong AI revenue crossing 10% of total.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance was only a flat‑to‑slight decline.
